title: Rule
alt: Four children form a circle, each raising one hand; a wheelchair user is part of the circle.
scene: Four diverse children sit in a circle on a bright rug, each with one hand raised together. One child uses a wheelchair positioned as part of the circle. No adult.
prompt: Use case: educational child-friendly illustration. Bright, simple flat artwork with large clear shapes, light ivory background, friendly to six-year-olds. Square single concept composition. Four diverse children sit in a circle on a bright rug, each with one hand raised together. One child uses a wheelchair positioned as part of the circle. No adult. Children visibly differ in skin tone, hair and build. No adult towering over a child, pointing, shaming or dominating. No prohibition signs, red slashes or crossed-out symbols. Absolutely no words, letters, numerals, writing, captions, labels, logos or watermark; paper and walls must be blank. The native application will add editable captions.
